info.title: YixuMemory P0 API draft
info.description: Design only; no deployed service. Server AuthContext is authoritative. Tenant path never grants permission. All writes reauthorize. Payload staging is specified in the separate agent extension draft; grant management, archive, conflict resolution and SDK generation remain reserved for later API revisions. Source erasure requires explicit erase-source capability and computes full dependency closure. P0-SC: eraseSource means only source_graph rooted at the named Event within this Space. Tenant/source/subject all-copies erasure is unsupported and rejected without side effects. All controlled copies in an accepted graph remain required for completion.

422.description: unsupported_erasure_scope or invalid target pairing; no job or fence created

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Conditionally mandatory for memory_graph: use current Memory ETag/version; missing -> 428, stale -> 412 before any fence. Event/Evidence roots are immutable, no Memory CAS required.

post.description: Explicit p0-sc-1 intent. Path/body scope selectors must match. Unsupported tenant/source_all_copies/subject_all_copies requests return 422 unsupported_erasure_scope before any erasure side effect (minimal rejection audit is permitted); denied graph returns 403/404. No partial execution. memory_graph retains the existing If-Match/CAS precondition (428 missing / 412 stale); this generic endpoint cannot bypass eraseMemory concurrency rules.
